name: Koyasunaga Mikihiko
source:
"Ugh... Ugh... This is too much..."

He is the youngest son in a family with three older sisters. He has effeminate behavior and appearance to the point of being mistaken for a woman because of such a home environment (you wouldn't know if he didn't tell you).

He has been bullied by his peers since he was young, so he is afraid of people and has a glass mentality that makes him cry.

The only friend he has is his doll, Pet-chan, that he has been playing with since he was born. (He is a ferret doll, not a cat doll.) Perhaps because he is interested in dolls, he is interested in ventriloquism, puppetry, etc.

As a result of his interests, he was admitted to Hope's Peak Academy with the talent of being a super high school level puppeteer.

He doesn't open up to people easily, but once you gets to know him, he's kind enough to be indescribable.

[Machine translated from [url=https://dangan.tistory.com/13?category=463600]official source[/url] and edited where necessary]
